micah: FYI starting v2 canary for /generate at 22:00 UTC (eu-west-1). tagging @nina @james for ops/replay. plan: canary(5%) -> hold -> slow shift. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: v2-preflight-2026-03-21 by micah. Canary shard: eu-west-1. Initial weight: 5%. Auto-ramp disabled until operator resume.

nina: I'll be on ops. micah paste pinlist and gateway exceptions?

micah: pinlist initial: tenant-314 (mobile sdk). withholding tenant-42 for now. Gateway: disable header-case-normalizer for tenant-314. Commands: `deploybot pin add tenant-314 --reason "mobile header compatibility"`

james: running replay against canary image, seeing intermittent 502s from eu-edge in smoke: [21:57:55Z] req=xyz001 status=502 backend=runtime-1 lat=1160ms; [21:57:56Z] req=xyz002 status=502 lat=1198ms. Could be kv-cache tuning or kernel selection.

nina: conservative approach: hold ramp at 10%, set auto-rollback: error_rate>2% (5m) OR p50>800ms (5m). Narrow pins to tenant-314 only.

micah: ack. pausing at 10% and removing tenant-42. Running: `deploybot pin remove tenant-42` now.

deploy-bot: Action: pin remove tenant-42 requested by micah. Status: succeeded. Canary paused at 10%. Active weight: 10%. Auto-rollback rules set: error_rate>2.0% (5m), p50>800ms (5m). Alerts -> #eng-oncall, #incidents.

elaine: updating release notes: note header-normalizer toggle for tenant-314 and canary held at 10% due to eu-edge smoke. Runbook updated with rollback thresholds and escalation contacts.

nina: if stable for 10m we can move to 25%. deploy-bot, please post baseline metrics every 5m. :thumbsup:

micah: baseline pre-roll: p50=220ms, error_rate=0.1%, p95=480ms. Posting telemetry snapshot in ~3m. Handing to on-call.

james: will try toggling kernel selector off in replay to see if 502s stop. prepping hotfix branch if rollback needed.

deploy-bot: Next operator action to resume ramp: `deploybot resume --canary v2-preflight-2026-03-21 --by micah` or auto-resume after 10m of stable metrics.
